content: On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), for every requested DID the Dcm module shall check if the DID can be read in the current mode condition (according to the configuration parameter DcmDspDidRead- ModeRuleRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send the calculated negative response of the referenced DcmModeRule .
